scope: BH-02 candidate internal host-neutral contract baseline and bounded headless, DOM, and native-spike evidence
method: Each lens independently challenged source-bound implementation and evidence. Prior phase labels and other lens outcomes were not treated as proof.
independence_limit: Seven separate evidence-first analytical lenses within the authorized Codex task; not external human review, professional certification, penetration testing, manual assistive-technology testing, or release audit.

lenses.scope: portable ownership, dependency direction, adapter isolation, native experiment boundary, change control
unresolved_risks: A downstream change could couple portable contracts to a concrete backend unless compatibility review remains mandatory.

lenses.scope: version-1 implementations, lifecycle behavior, failure paths, package metadata truth
unresolved_risks: Incremental reconciliation, hydration, server transport, and production providers remain deliberately unimplemented.

lenses.scope: representative slice, canonical traces, backend result boundaries, stale rejection and disposal
unresolved_risks: Only Linux GTK has direct native execution; Windows and macOS behavior is source-only and deferred.
File-choice provider interaction is not executed.

lenses.scope: semantic intent, roles, focus, selection, validation relationships, qualified-evidence boundaries
unresolved_risks: GTK default roles do not satisfy every requested role.
Manual assistive-technology, touch, reflow, forced-color, and screen-reader evidence is absent.

lenses.scope: portable data validation, stale generation rejection, capability boundaries, production nonclaims
unresolved_risks: Production authentication, deployment, CSP, audit, persistence, and penetration-test controls remain outside BH-02.

lenses.scope: local dependency graph, experiment isolation, payload/release boundaries, package metadata
unresolved_risks: Payload budget, reachability, SBOM, notices, signing, publication, rollback, and release invalidation are unexecuted.

lenses.scope: source ownership, generated evidence lineage, external dependencies, distributed-material nonclaims
unresolved_risks: A later distributed package or binary requires a fresh license, notice, SBOM, and artifact provenance audit.
